title: AgentFinding
description: One finding of a review, a hunt or a security pass. The verdict is the evidence bar, not the severity: `confirmed` means the finding was reproduced or re-read and carries `severity` and `confidence`; `needs_validation` is an unprovable claim turned into a lead with an exact `blockers` entry and a `validation_plan`, and it has no severity by design (never noise, never a silent pass); `rejected` says why it does not stand. `fingerprint` is the stable identity — repository-relative file plus whitespace-normalised, lowercased text — so a re-wrapped finding keeps its id while a real rewording becomes a new one. `trace` and `evidence` carry repository-relative locations and the commands or answers that show the fact. A validator must also refuse `severity.overall_severity` above the demonstrated `severity.impact`; the schema cannot rank two enums, so `description` states the rule.

verdict.description: confirmed: reproduced or re-read by a second agent. needs_validation: a lead that could not be proven locally; it carries blockers and a plan, never a severity. rejected: the claim was refuted; it carries a reason.

fingerprint.description: The stable id: repository-relative file + whitespace-normalised, lowercased finding text (for example `server/x.js:the cache never expires`).

description.description: What is wrong, in plain words; no severity claim beyond the evidence.

trace.description: Where the issue lives, repository-relative, most specific first.

evidence.description: What shows the fact: the source read, the command and its output, the response, the screenshot or the test.

claimed_root_cause.description: The suspected cause of a needs_validation lead, stated as a claim to test.

blockers.description: The exact reason the claim could not be proven here (a credential, an environment, data, a downstream service).

reason.description: Why a rejected claim does not stand.

file.description: Repository-relative path; no leading slash and no `..`.

line.description: The line the finding is about, when it is one line.

symbol.description: The function, route or job the line belongs to.

kind.description: What kind of evidence this is.

summary.description: What this shows, in one sentence.

severity.description: The two axes stay separate: likelihood is how easily it is reached, impact is what it does, overall_severity may not exceed impact.

local.description: How to prove or refute the lead on a machine with the repository.

deployment.description: How to prove or refute it where only a deployed service, its data or its credentials can.
